label: full-B02
brief: Extend this clip (attached) by 10 seconds, widescreen, silent, continuing directly from its last frame. For context, the clip was made from this story: A small neighbourhood barber shop on a quiet weekday afternoon: one black leather chair in front of a wide mirror with round bulbs, a worn wooden counter with clippers, combs and a talc brush, a striped pole outside the front window, warm tungsten light inside and soft daylight from the window. Marcus, the barber, mid-forties, shaved head, grey beard, black apron over a white t-shirt. Dev, the customer, early twenties, in the chair with a black cape, short dark hair being finished into a fade. What the clip showed: Marcus finishes the fade on Dev's right side with the clippers, steps back, tilts his head to check the line, then picks up the talc brush and dusts Dev's neck. Dev looks into the mirror. End on Marcus lifting the cape at Dev's shoulders, about to take it off. What happens next: Marcus pulls the cape off with a flick and shakes it out. Dev stands, runs a hand over the fresh fade in the mirror and grins. Marcus holds up a hand mirror behind Dev's head so he can see the back; Dev nods, satisfied. They shake hands by the counter. End on Dev turning toward the door, Marcus already brushing down the chair.

extend.prompt: Use the supplied image as the starting frame and strict reference; continue seamlessly. 10 seconds, 16:9, audio off. PRESERVE Marcus, partly cropped at left behind Dev: bald head, long gray beard, tattooed forearms with white T-shirt/black apron. PRESERVE Dev, seated foreground center facing the mirror: thick dark top with skin fade, same youthful face, white neck strip above black cape. Preserve the worn wood counter and its tools; bulb-framed mirrors and accurate reflections; empty red-and-white chair at left; tall windows, exterior pole and traffic. Match the reference’s realism, warm bulbs, daylight and color. One continuous shot with one slow pullback, revealing room to stand without changing sides. 0–2s: continuing his existing grip at Dev’s left shoulder, Marcus flicks the cape clear of Dev’s neck and shakes it out once, then drapes it on the counter. 2–4s: Dev stands, watches himself in the central mirror, runs one hand over his fresh fade and grins. 4–6s: Marcus lifts a hand mirror from the counter behind Dev’s head, angling it toward the wall mirror; Dev looks at the reflected back of his haircut and nods, satisfied. 6–7s: Marcus lowers the mirror onto the counter; they meet eyes and exchange one brief handshake beside it, then release. 7–8s: Dev turns toward the door while Marcus picks up a brush and starts brushing down the vacated chair. Final two seconds: settle and hold on Dev, angled toward the door with a pleased face, Marcus continuing the same brushing motion behind him. Negatives: no cuts, identity drift, extra people, independent mirror figures, warped hands, extra limbs, intersecting bodies, floating tools, cape clipping, text or audio.

people: Barber: bald man with a long gray beard, tattooed forearms, a white short-sleeved T-shirt, and a black apron. He stands behind and to the client's left.

Client: young man with thick dark hair on top and a close skin fade around the sides and back, wearing a white neck strip beneath a black barber cape. He sits upright facing the mirror with a neutral expression.
The repeated figures deeper in the mirrors are reflections of the same barber and client, not clearly separate people.
seen.last_moment: The client's head and shoulders fill the foreground, with the back of his freshly faded haircut toward the camera and his neutral face visible in the central mirror. The barber is partly cropped at the left edge, looking down as he grips the cape near the client's left shoulder and pulls its left side outward. The white neck strip is exposed above the cape. Both remain at the chair in front of the tool-covered counter.
seen.natural_next: The barber would likely continue loosening and drawing the cape away from the client's shoulders, gathering it to keep loose hair contained. The client would probably remain seated facing the mirror while the barber finishes this cleanup; he might then be ready to get out of the chair.
seen.scene: A traditional barbershop with worn dark-wood counters, large wooden-framed mirrors bordered by glowing round bulbs, and an empty red-and-white barber chair at the left. Clippers, combs, brushes, and bottles lie along the counter. Daylight enters through tall street-facing windows, with a barber pole and passing traffic visible outside, mixing with the warm mirror lights. The camera moves closer and slightly right, progressing from a wide side/rear view to a tight view behind the client's head.
seen.action_so_far: The barber begins working with a small tool at the back of the client's head and neckline, apparently finishing the haircut. He then sweeps his arm across the shoulder and neck area and starts handling the cape. As the camera closes in, he pulls the cape outward from the client's left side. The client stays seated and largely still, watching himself in the mirror.
